text:
Alexa: Quick proposal — shift daily handoff to micro-handoffs: two 10-min check-ins at 08:00 and 20:00 on weekdays. Only escalate to a full triage call if there's a P1 or >3 open P2s. Thoughts? cc: @Drew @Mika
Ben: I like it. Short, focused, and fewer long meetings. How do we handle weekends?
Carmen: Suggest trial Mon-Fri for 2 weeks and measure handoff duration + any incident churn.
Drew: Agree to trial. Who should be on the 10-min? Oncall + shift lead + owning eng? Need clarity for infra/runtime coverage.
Mika: I can update OncallBot to post reminders and attach a quick incident snapshot. Proposed cron: ```0 8,20 * * 1-5```
Alexa: Perfect. Also proposing a weekly escalation rotation across infra/runtime/platform teams (one team per week). I'll post the rotation matrix unless there are objections.
Ben: No objections. One request — make the snapshot include open incidents count + top 3 active alerts so triage decisions are faster.
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: micro-handoff reminders at 08:00 and 20:00 weekdays. Template: "Handoff: oncall, shift lead, open incidents: X, top alerts: [A,B,C]"
Carmen: I'll own the triage metrics collection (handoff length, reopened incidents). Will create a tiny dashboard and share the link in #eng-oncall.
Drew: Can we add a "buddy oncall" field so escalation pings go to a secondary if primary is OOO?
Alexa: Yes — Mika, please add a buddy field to the rotation config. We'll start the trial next Monday (two-week window). Mika, can you push the config by Friday EOD?
Mika: Will do. I'll push the config, update OncallBot, and open a PR with the cron + template by Friday.
Ben: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone, sounds good to start the trial.
